court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bareilly — Case No. unknown
case_name: Smt. Mohit Preet Kapoor vs Sumit Kapoor
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2013. The husband filed a divorce petition in 2017 alleging that the wife had deserted him without reason and refused to cohabit. The trial court allowed the petition. The wife appealed.

legal_principles.principle: The credibility of a witness can be impeached by showing that the witness had no knowledge about certain facts.
legal_principles.held: The statement of P.W-3 in this regard is not credible, in as much as, he admitted that he was not related to the family on two crucial dates.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party who asserts a fact to prove it.
legal_principles.held: At least, this can be elicited that P.W-3, P.W-4 and P.W-5 are the persons who had no knowledge as to whether the appellant had actually left her matrimonial home on 10.1.2015 with the intention to end her matrimonial relationship.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is allowed, and the judgment of the trial court is set aside.

use_for_drafting: preparing appeal against family court order
